source.description: Project decoder parse point where attacker-controlled compressed AV1 OBU/frame-header bytes enter the frame setup logic.
source.note: The fuzz harness reads an IVF frame and calls aom_codec_decode; the scored source is the AV1 decoder parsing compressed OBU/frame-header bytes, not LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput.
source.value_from: Attacker-controlled AV1 bitstream fields enter decoder state through the OBU/header parser.; value `data / rb`; from `return av1_decode_frame_headers_and_setup(pbi, rb, data, p_data_end,`

tainted_value_origin.description: First vulnerability-relevant parsed state: frame header fields select the key-frame path and frame-size setup.
tainted_value_origin.note: The attacker-controlled header leads to setup_frame_size/setup_buffer_pool and later reset_frame_buffers on the same decode path.

sink.description: ASan crash location: a 16-bit neutral-grey store writes through buf->buffers[plane] after that frame buffer was released.

root_cause.description: Root cause: reset_frame_buffers releases every non-current frame buffer but still calls set_planes_to_neutral_grey for every frame_bufs[i].buf in the loop. For released non-current buffers, buf->buffers[plane] can point to freed raw frame memory.

coarse_trace.summary: Header state enters key-frame/frame-size setup and buffer-pool management.
Reallocates the current frame buffer; ASan free stack shows old raw buffer storage released through av1_get_frame_buffer.
Releases non-current buffers and then resets all frame buffers regardless of release state.
Writes neutral-grey pixels through a buffer pointer that may refer to freed storage.

fine_trace.note: Compressed attacker-controlled AV1 frame-header bytes enter the decoder header setup path.
Parsed frame-header state selects the key-frame setup path.
Parsed frame size/sequence state leads to frame-buffer allocation/reallocation for the selected new frame buffer.
ASan free stack shows old raw frame storage being freed when the required frame buffer size grows.
For non-current frame buffers, reset releases the raw frame buffer.

The vulnerable loop calls neutral-grey reset for all frame buffers, including non-current buffers just released at line 4392. The patch moves this call into the current-buffer else branch and adds a size check.
The released frame buffer pointer is converted into a writable high-bitdepth pixel pointer.
ASan reports a 2-byte heap-use-after-free WRITE here.

format.name: AV1 bitstream
format.contract: Candidate input must remain parser-admissible for av1_dec_fuzzer, through read_uncompressed_header, while preserving attacker control over cm->frame_type / frame_size_override_flag, so execution reaches reset_frame_buffers and the sink in set_planes_to_neutral_grey.

parser_admitted.description: The PoC is admitted far enough to execute read_uncompressed_header on the path toward the annotated source/root-cause/sink chain.
